ko.title: 소매업 성적표: 월마트, 타겟, 홈디포의 실적이 미국 소비자에 대해 말해주는 것

segments.src: Every mid-November, three of America's biggest retailers report quarterly results within days of one another: Walmart, Target and Home Depot.
segments.tr: 매년 11월 중순이면 미국의 대표적인 대형 소매업체 세 곳인 월마트, 타겟, 홈디포가 며칠 간격으로 분기 실적을 발표합니다.

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: 이들은 식료품, 의류, 완구, 전자제품, 가구, 공구 및 건축 자재를 함께 판매합니다.

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: 이러한 폭넓은 품목 덕분에 이들의 실적 시즌은 홀리데이 시즌 직전의 가계 지출을 보여주는 가장 훌륭한 공개 스냅샷 중 하나가 됩니다.

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 이러한 보고서가 무엇인지, 어떤 수치에 주목해야 하는지, 그리고 경영진의 코멘트를 비판적인 시각으로 읽는 방법을 다룹니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 투자 조언이 아니고, 어떤 기업의 실적을 예측하는 것도 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## 왜 이 세 회사인가?

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: 각 회사는 가계 예산에서 서로 다른 부문을 차지하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **Walmart**(월마트)는 미국 최대의 식료품점이자 일용품 주요 판매업체입니다. 고객층의 소득 스펙트럼이 넓기 때문에, 이들의 실적은 예산에 민감한 소비자와 고소득 소비자 모두가 어떻게 행동하고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **Target**(타겟)은 의류, 홈 데코, 완구, 시즌 용품 등 임의 소비재 카테고리에 치중되어 있습니다. 소비자 심리 변화에 더 민감한 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **Home Depot**(홈디포)는 주택 시장과 주택 개량(인테리어)을 보여주는 창입니다. 대규모 프로젝트, 수리, 전문 계약업체 수요가 모두 이 숫자에 나타납니다.

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: 이 세 곳을 나란히 읽어보면 어느 한 곳만으로는 얻을 수 없는 더 온전한 그림을 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## 주목해야 할 수치

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. 동일점 매출

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: "동일점 매출"(또는 "comps")은 1년 이상 영업 중인 매장과 채널의 매출을 측정합니다.

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: 신규 개점과 폐점의 영향을 배제하기 때문에 기저 수요를 더 명확하게 가늠할 수 있는 지표입니다.

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: 단일 분기의 수치뿐만 아니라 변화의 방향과 속도를 살펴보세요.

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. 방문객 수 대비 객단가

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: 동일점 매출은 거래 건수(방문객 수)와 거래당 평균 지출 금액(객단가)의 두 가지로 나눌 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: 대체로 가격 상승으로 인해 늘어난 매출은 더 많은 쇼핑객이 더 많은 품목을 구매하여 발생한 매출과 매우 다른 이야기를 전달합니다.

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: 기업이 두 가지 모두를 공시할 때 이를 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. 재고 수준

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: 재고는 소매업체가 느끼는 자신감을 보여주는 단서입니다.

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: 적정 재고는 규율을 의미할 수도 있고, 텅 빈 선반의 위험을 의미할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: 불어난 재고는 수요 부진과 향후 가격 인하(할인 판매) 라운드를 암시할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: 재고 증가율이 매출 증가율과 어떻게 비교되는지 관찰하세요.

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: 매출총이익률과 영업이익률은 비용을 제외하고 매출 1달러당 회사가 얼마나 보유하는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: 압박 요인은 운송비, 임금, 재고 손실(도난 및 손실), 프로모션, 제품 믹스에서 올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: 경영진은 마진 변화를 상세히 설명하는 경우가 많으며, 그 설명을 자세히 읽어볼 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. 이커머스 및 디지털 성장

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: 온라인 주문, 당일 배송, 매장 픽업, 리테일 미디어(소매업체 자체 플랫폼에서 판매되는 광고)는 핵심 스토리의 주요 부분이 되었습니다.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: 이러한 영역의 성장은 매출과 이익을 끌어올릴 수 있지만, 더 높은 이행 비용을 수반할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. 실적 전망(가이드언스)

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: 기업들은 대개 남은 회계연도에 대한 전망을 제시합니다.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: 전망을 상향 조정하는지, 유지하는지, 하향 조정하는지, 그리고 얼마나 여유(완충재)를 두는지가 방금 마감된 분기보다 대화를 더 크게 움직이는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## 경영진 코멘트의 행간 읽기

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: 실적 발표 컨퍼런스 콜은 어느 정도 각본에 따라 진행되지만, 그럼에도 패턴은 나타납니다.

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: 귀 기울여 들어야 할 몇 가지 사항은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?
segments.tr: - **저가 제품으로의 이동 또는 고가 제품으로의 이동.** 소비자들이 자체브랜드(PB), 소용량 포장, 또는 더 저렴한 대안을 선택하고 있나요? 아니 여전히 프리미엄 제품을 구매하고 있나요?

segments.src: - **Promotions and discounts.** Heavier discounting early in the season may suggest that retailers are working harder to win sales.
segments.tr: - **프로모션 및 할인.** 시즌 초반의 더 과감한 할인은 소매업체들이 매출을 올리기 위해 더 애쓰고 있음을 시사할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Big-ticket hesitation.** Home Depot's remarks about large projects, and Target's remarks about discretionary goods, can reveal how willing households are to make larger purchases.
segments.tr: - **고가 품목 구매 망설임.** 대형 프로젝트에 대한 홈디포의 언급과 임의 소비재에 대한 타겟의 언급은 가계가 더 큰 구매를 기꺼이 할 의향이 있는지 드러낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Credit and payment habits.** Mentions of buy-now-pay-later use, or shoppers stretching paychecks between pay dates, hint at budget strain.
segments.tr: - **신용 및 결제 습관.** 선구매-후결제(BNPL) 이용 언급이나 쇼핑객들이 급여일 사이에 급여를 쪼개어 쓰는 모습은 예산 압박을 암시합니다.

segments.src: - **Tariffs, supply chains and pricing.** Executives often discuss how costs are passed along, absorbed or avoided through sourcing changes.
segments.tr: - **관세, 공급망 및 가격 책정.** 경영진은 소싱 변경을 통해 비용이 어떻게 전가되는지, 흡수되는지, 또는 회피되는지 종종 논의합니다.

segments.src: - **Holiday expectations.** Cautious language about timing, early shopping or shorter gift lists is worth noting.
segments.tr: - **홀리데이 기대치.** 시기, 이른 쇼핑, 또는 짧아진 선물 목록에 대한 신중한 언어는 주목할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Putting It in Context
segments.tr: ## 맥락 속에서 파악하기

segments.src: A few cautions help keep the reading honest:
segments.tr: 다음 몇 가지 주의사항은 객관적인 시각을 유지하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: 1. **One quarter is not a trend.** Weather, calendar shifts and one-time events can distort a single period.
segments.tr: 1. **한 분기는 트렌드가 아닙니다.** 날씨, 캘린더 이동, 일회성 이벤트는 단일 기간을 왜곡할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Compare against expectations.** Markets react to results relative to forecasts, not only to the raw figures.
segments.tr: 2. **예상치와 비교하세요.** 시장은 단순한 수치뿐만 아니라 전망치에 상대적인 결과에 반응합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Companies report their own view.** Pair earnings with independent data such as government retail sales and inflation reports, consumer sentiment surveys and credit data.
segments.tr: 3. **기업은 자체적인 관점을 보고합니다.** 실적을 정부의 소매 판매 및 인플레이션 보고서, 소비자 심리 조사, 신용 데이터 등 독립적인 데이터와 결합하세요.

segments.src: 4. **Averages hide differences.** Households with different incomes, ages and regions can behave very differently within the same quarter.
segments.tr: 4. **평균은 차이를 가립니다.** 소득, 연령, 지역이 다른 가계는 동일한 분기 내에서도 매우 다르게 행동할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Readers
segments.tr: ## 일반 독자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: You do not need to own a single share to benefit from these reports.
segments.tr: 이러한 보고서로부터 혜택을 받기 위해 주식을 한 주도 보유할 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: If you are planning holiday spending, early discounts and strong inventories may mean better deals, while cautious retailers might limit selection on popular items.
segments.tr: 홀리데이 지출을 계획 중이라면, 이른 할인과 탄탄한 재고는 더 나은 혜택을 의미할 수 있는 반면, 신중한 소매업체들은 인기 품목의 선택 폭을 제한할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If you work in retail, logistics or construction, the commentary hints at hiring and demand ahead.
segments.tr: 소매, 물류, 건설 업계에 종사하신다면 코멘트에서 향후 고용과 수요에 대한 힌트를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: And if you simply want to understand the economy, these earnings calls are one of the most readable, plain-language views of how Americans are spending.
segments.tr: 그리고 단순히 경제를 이해하고 싶다면, 이러한 실적 발표 콜은 미국인들이 어떻게 소비하고 있는지 보여주는 가장 읽기 쉽고 평이한 언어의 관점 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: The mid-November reports from Walmart, Target and Home Depot function like a report card for the consumer economy.
segments.tr: 월마트, 타겟, 홈디포의 11월 중순 보고서는 소비자 경제의 성적표와 같은 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Focus on comparable sales, traffic versus ticket, inventory, margins and guidance, then compare what executives say with independent data.
segments.tr: 동일점 매출, 방문객 수 대비 객단가, 재고, 마진, 가이드언스에 초점을 맞추고 경영진의 발언을 독립적인 데이터와 비교해 보세요.

segments.src: That approach gives you a grounded, balanced view of how the American shopper is really doing as the holiday season begins.
segments.tr: 그러한 접근 방식은 홀리데이 시즌이 시작됨에 따라 미국 소비자가 실제로 어떻게 지내고 있는지에 대한 현실적이고 균형 잡힌 시각을 제공합니다.

segments.tr: *본 문서는 정보 제공 목적으로만 제공되며 재무, 투자 또는 법적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Company reporting dates and figures should be confirmed through official company announcements.*
segments.tr: 기업의 실적 발표일과 수치는 공식적인 기업 공지를 통해 확인해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 零售业成绩单：沃尔玛、目标百货与家得宝财报揭示的美国消费者现状

segments.src: Every mid-November, three of America's biggest retailers report quarterly results within days of one another: Walmart, Target and Home Depot.
segments.tr: 每年11月中旬，美国三家最大的零售商都会在几天之内先后公布季度业绩：沃尔玛（Walmart）、目标百货（Target）和家得宝（Home Depot）。

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: 它们涵盖了食品杂货、服装、玩具、电子产品、家具、工具和建筑材料的销售。

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: 这种广泛的业务覆盖，使它们的财报季成为假期前观察家庭消费状况的最佳公开窗口之一。

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: 本指南将介绍这些财报包含什么内容、哪些数据值得关注，以及如何以批判的眼光解读高管们的点评。

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: 本文仅供一般信息参考，不构成投资建议，也不预测任何公司的业绩。

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## 为什么是这三家公司？

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: 每一家公司都切中了家庭预算的不同领域。

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **沃尔玛** 是美国最大的食品杂货商和日常用品的主要销售商。它的客户群体涵盖了广泛的收入阶层，因此其业绩通常能反映出预算紧缩型和高收入型消费者的行为模式。

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **目标百货** 更偏向于非必需品类，如服装、家居饰品、玩具和季节性商品。它对消费者信心的变化往往更为敏感。

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **家得宝** 是观察住房市场和房屋改善的窗口。大型项目、维修以及专业承包商的需求都会体现在其数据中。

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: 将这三家公司的财报放在一起横向对比，能提供比其中任何单一家公司更全面的全景图。

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## 值得关注的核心数据

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. 同店销售额（Comparable Sales）

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: “同店销售额”（或“可比销售额”）衡量的是开业至少一年的门店和渠道的销售情况。

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: 它排除了新开门店和关店的影响，因此能更纯粹地衡量潜在的需求。

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: 不仅要看单一季度的数字，还要看其变化的方向和节奏。

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. 客流量与客单价（Traffic Versus Ticket）

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: 同店销售额可以拆分为两部分：交易笔数（客流量）和每笔交易的平均花费金额（客单价）。

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: 主要由提价驱动的销售额增长，与由更多顾客购买更多商品驱动的增长，所传达的信息大相径庭。

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: 当公司同时披露这两项数据时，不妨将它们进行对比。

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. 库存水平

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: 库存是了解零售商信心强弱的一条线索。

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: 精简的库存可能意味着经营严谨，也可能意味着面临货架空置的风险。

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: 库存过高则可能意味着需求疲软以及即将到来的一轮打折促销。

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: 留意库存增长与销售额增长的对比情况。

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: 毛利率和营业利润率显示了公司在扣除成本后，每1美元销售额能保留多少收益。

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: 利润压力可能来自运费、工资、损耗（盗窃与损失）、促销活动和产品组合。

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: 管理层通常会详细解释利润率的变化，这些解释值得仔细研读。

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 3. 电商与数字化增长

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: 线上订单、当日送达、路边自提以及零售媒体（在零售商自家平台上售卖的广告）已成为业绩故事的重要组成部分。

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: 这些领域的增长可以拉动销售额和利润，但也可能会带来更高的履约成本。

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. 业绩指引（Guidance）

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: 公司通常会给出本财年剩余时间的业绩展望。

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: 无论它们是上调、维持还是下调指引，以及预留了多少缓冲空间，往往比刚结束的这个季度的实际表现更能影响市场情绪。

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## 读懂管理层发言的字里行间

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: 财报电话会议虽然部分按照稿件进行，但依然能看出规律。

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: 以下是需要注意的几个方面：

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?
segments.tr: - **向下消费还是向上消费。** 消费者是在选择自有品牌、更小包装还是更便宜的替代品？还是他们依然在购买高端商品？

segments.src: - **Promotions and discounts.** Heavier discounting early in the season may suggest that retailers are working harder to win sales.
segments.tr: - **促销与折扣。** 季度早期的力度更大的折扣可能表明零售商正在更努力地争取销售额。

segments.src: - **Big-ticket hesitation.** Home Depot's remarks about large projects, and Target's remarks about discretionary goods, can reveal how willing households are to make larger purchases.
segments.tr: - **对大额消费的犹豫。** 家得宝对大型项目的表态，以及目标百货对非必需品的言论，可以揭示家庭进行大额消费的意愿。

segments.src: - **Credit and payment habits.** Mentions of buy-now-pay-later use, or shoppers stretching paychecks between pay dates, hint at budget strain.
segments.tr: - **信用与支付习惯。** 提及“先买后付”的使用，或者消费者在两次发薪日之间紧缩开支，都暗示着预算吃紧。

segments.src: - **Tariffs, supply chains and pricing.** Executives often discuss how costs are passed along, absorbed or avoided through sourcing changes.
segments.tr: - **关税、供应链与定价。** 高管们经常讨论如何通过调整采购渠道来转嫁、吸收或规避成本。

segments.src: - **Holiday expectations.** Cautious language about timing, early shopping or shorter gift lists is worth noting.
segments.tr: - **假期预期。** 关于购物时机、提前购物或缩减礼物清单等方面的谨慎措辞值得留心。

segments.src: ## Putting It in Context
segments.tr: ## 结合背景综合分析

segments.src: A few cautions help keep the reading honest:
segments.tr: 以下几点注意事项有助于保持客观解读：

segments.src: 1. **One quarter is not a trend.** Weather, calendar shifts and one-time events can distort a single period.
segments.tr: 1. **单一季度不代表长期趋势。** 天气、日历错位和一次性事件可能会扭曲单个期间的数据。

segments.src: 2. **Compare against expectations.** Markets react to results relative to forecasts, not only to the raw figures.
segments.tr: 2. **对比市场预期。** 市场是根据业绩相对于预测的表现做出反应，而不仅仅看原始数字。

segments.src: 3. **Companies report their own view.** Pair earnings with independent data such as government retail sales and inflation reports, consumer sentiment surveys and credit data.
segments.tr: 3. **公司报告的是自身视角。** 将财报与独立数据相结合，例如政府的零售销售和通胀报告、消费者信心调查以及信贷数据。

segments.src: 4. **Averages hide differences.** Households with different incomes, ages and regions can behave very differently within the same quarter.
segments.tr: 4. **平均数掩盖了差异。** 不同收入、年龄和地区的家庭在同一个季度内的表现可能截然不同。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Readers
segments.tr: ## 这对普通读者意味着什么

segments.src: You do not need to own a single share to benefit from these reports.
segments.tr: 即使你一股股票也不持有，也能从这些财报中获益。

segments.src: If you are planning holiday spending, early discounts and strong inventories may mean better deals, while cautious retailers might limit selection on popular items.
segments.tr: 如果你正在计划节日消费，早期的折扣和充沛的库存可能意味着更好的优惠，而谨慎的零售商可能会限制热门商品的款式选择。

segments.src: If you work in retail, logistics or construction, the commentary hints at hiring and demand ahead.
segments.tr: 如果你从事零售、物流或建筑行业，高管的点评预示着未来的招聘和需求趋势。

segments.src: And if you simply want to understand the economy, these earnings calls are one of the most readable, plain-language views of how Americans are spending.
segments.tr: 如果你只是想了解经济状况，这些财报电话会议是以最通俗易懂的方式观察美国人消费现状的途径之一。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: The mid-November reports from Walmart, Target and Home Depot function like a report card for the consumer economy.
segments.tr: 沃尔玛、目标百货和家得宝在11月中旬公布的财报，就像是消费者经济的一份成绩单。

segments.src: Focus on comparable sales, traffic versus ticket, inventory, margins and guidance, then compare what executives say with independent data.
segments.tr: 重点关注同店销售额、客流量与客单价、库存、利润率和业绩指引，然后将管理层的言论与独立数据进行对比。

segments.src: That approach gives you a grounded, balanced view of how the American shopper is really doing as the holiday season begins.
segments.tr: 这种方法能让你在假期季开始之际，对美国消费者的真实状况有一个切实、平衡的认识。

hi.title: रिटेल का रिपोर्ट कार्ड: Walmart, Target और Home Depot की कमाई अमेरिकी खरीदार के बारे में क्या बताती है

segments.src: Every mid-November, three of America's biggest retailers report quarterly results within days of one another: Walmart, Target and Home Depot.
segments.tr: हर साल नवंबर के मध्य में, अमेरिका के तीन सबसे बड़े रिटेलर्स एक-दूसरे के कुछ ही दिनों के भीतर अपने त्रैमासिक परिणामों की रिपोर्ट देते हैं: Walmart, Target और Home Depot।

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: ये मिलकर किराने का सामान, कपड़े, खिलौने, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स, फर्नीचर, उपकरण और निर्माण सामग्री बेचते हैं।

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: यह व्यापकता छुट्टियों से ठीक पहले घरेलू खर्च का सबसे बेहतरीन सार्वजनिक स्नैपशॉट पेश करती है।

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: यह गाइड यह बताती है कि ये रिपोर्ट क्या हैं, किन आंकड़ों पर ध्यान देने की जरूरत है, और कार्यकारी टिप्पणियों को आलोचनात्मक नजर से कैसे पढ़ा जाए।

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, निवेश सलाह नहीं, और यह किसी भी कंपनी के परिणामों की भविष्यवाणी नहीं करती है।

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## ये तीन कंपनियां ही क्यों?

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक कंपनी घरेलू बजट के एक अलग हिस्से से संबंधित है।

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **Walmart** देश का सबसे बड़ा किराना विक्रेता है और रोज़मर्रा के सामान का एक प्रमुख विक्रेता है। इसके ग्राहक आय के व्यापक वर्ग में फैले हुए हैं, इसलिए इसके परिणाम अक्सर दिखाते हैं कि बजट के प्रति सचेत और उच्च-आय वाले खरीदार दोनों कैसा व्यवहार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **Target** परिधान, होम डेकोर, खिलौने और मौसमी वस्तुओं जैसी गैर-ज़रूरी श्रेणियों (discretionary categories) की ओर अधिक झुकाव रखता है। यह उपभोक्ता विश्वास में बदलावों के प्रति अधिक संवेदनशील होता है।

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **Home Depot** आवास बाज़ार और गृह सुधार (home improvement) के क्षेत्र में एक खिड़की की तरह है। बड़ी परियोजनाएं, मरम्मत और पेशेवर ठेकेदार की मांग इसके आंकड़ों में दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: इन तीनों को साथ मिलाकर पढ़ने से किसी एक कंपनी द्वारा दिए गए चित्र की तुलना में एक अधिक पूर्ण तस्वीर मिलती है।

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## ध्यान देने योग्य आंकड़े

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. तुलनीय बिक्री (Comparable Sales)

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: "तुलनीय बिक्री" (या "comps") उन स्टोरों और चैनलों में बिक्री को मापती है जो कम से कम एक वर्ष से खुले हैं।

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: वे नए स्टोर के खुलने और बंद होने के प्रभाव को हटा देते हैं, इसलिए वे अंतर्निहित मांग का एक अधिक सटीक पैमाना हैं।

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: केवल एक तिमाही के आंकड़े के बजाय बदलाव की दिशा और गति को देखें।

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. ट्रैफिक बनाम टिकट

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: तुलनीय बिक्री को दो भागों में विभाजित किया जा सकता है: लेनदेन की संख्या (ट्रैफिक) और प्रति लेनदेन खर्च की गई औसत राशि (टिकट)।

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: मुख्य रूप से ऊंची कीमतों से प्रेरित बढ़ती बिक्री, अधिक सामान खरीदने वाले अधिक खरीदारों से प्रेरित बिक्री से बहुत अलग कहानी बताती है।

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: जब कंपनियां दोनों का खुलासा करती हैं, तो उनकी तुलना करें।

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. इन्वेंट्री का स्तर

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: इन्वेंट्री इस बात का सुराग है कि कोई रिटेलर कितना आश्वस्त महसूस करता है।

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: कम इन्वेंट्री अनुशासन या खाली अलमारियों के जोखिम का संकेत दे सकती है।

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: अत्यधिक इन्वेंट्री कमजोर मांग और आने वाले छूट चक्र का संकेत दे सकती है।

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: देखें कि इन्वेंट्री वृद्धि की तुलना बिक्री वृद्धि से कैसे होती है।

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: सकल (gross) और परिचालन (operating) मार्जिन बताते हैं कि लागत के बाद कंपनी बिक्री के प्रत्येक डॉलर में से कितना हिस्सा अपने पास रखती है।

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: भाड़ा, मजदूरी, चोरी व नुकसान (shrink), प्रचार और उत्पाद मिश्रण (product mix) से दबाव आ सकता है।

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: अधिकारी अक्सर मार्जिन परिवर्तनों को विस्तार से समझाते हैं, और उन स्पष्टीकरणों को ध्यान से पढ़ना फायदेमंद होता है।

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. ई-कॉमर्स और डिजिटल वृद्धि

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: ऑनलाइन ऑर्डर, उसी दिन डिलीवरी, कर्बसाइड पिकअप और रिटेल मीडिया (रिटेलर के अपने प्लेटफॉर्म पर बेचे जाने वाले विज्ञापन) इस कहानी के प्रमुख हिस्से बन गए हैं।

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: इन क्षेत्रों में वृद्धि से बिक्री और मुनाफा बढ़ सकता है, लेकिन इनसे पूर्ति (fulfillment) लागत भी अधिक हो सकती है।

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. मार्गदर्शन (Guidance)

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: कंपनियां आमतौर पर शेष वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए एक दृष्टिकोण (guidance) देती हैं।

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: चाहे वे इसे बढ़ाएं, बनाए रखें या घटाएं, और इसमें कितना कुशन रखते हैं, यह अक्सर अभी पूरी हुई तिमाही की तुलना में चर्चा को अधिक प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## कार्यकारी टिप्पणियों के छिपे अर्थ को समझना

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: अर्निंग्स कॉल आंशिक रूप से पटकथा पर आधारित (scripted) होती हैं, फिर भी पैटर्न उभर कर आते हैं।

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: सुनने योग्य कुछ बातें:

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?

es.title: Boletín de calificaciones del comercio minorista: Lo que revelan las ganancias de Walmart, Target y Home Depot sobre el consumidor estadounidense

segments.src: Every mid-November, three of America's biggest retailers report quarterly results within days of one another: Walmart, Target and Home Depot.
segments.tr: A mediados de cada noviembre, tres de los minoristas más grandes de Estados Unidos reportan sus resultados trimestrales con pocos días de diferencia entre sí: Walmart, Target y Home Depot.

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: Juntos venden comestibles, ropa, juguetes, productos electrónicos, muebles, herramientas y materiales de construcción.

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: Esa amplitud hace que su temporada de ganancias sea una de las mejores instantáneas públicas del gasto de los hogares justo antes de las fiestas.

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: Esta guía cubre qué son estos informes, qué números merecen atención y cómo leer los comentarios de los ejecutivos con ojo crítico.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento de inversión, y no predice los resultados de ninguna empresa.

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## ¿Por qué estas tres empresas?

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: Cada una se sitúa en una parte diferente del presupuesto familiar.

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **Walmart** es el mayor vendedor de comestibles del país y un importante vendedor de productos cotidianos. Sus clientes abarcan una amplia gama de ingresos, por lo que sus resultados a menudo muestran cómo se comportan tanto los compradores conscientes del presupuesto como los de mayores ingresos.

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **Target** se inclina hacia categorías discrecionales como ropa, decoración del hogar, juguetes y artículos de temporada. Tiende a ser más sensible a los cambios en la confianza del consumidor.

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **Home Depot** es una ventana al mercado inmobiliario y a las mejoras para el hogar. Los grandes proyectos, las reparaciones y la demanda de contratistas profesionales aparecen en sus números.

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: Leer los tres uno al lado del otro ofrece una imagen más completa de la que cualquiera de ellos puede ofrecer por sí solo.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Los números que vale la pena observar

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. Ventas comparables

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: "Ventas comparables" (o "comps") miden las ventas en tiendas y canales abiertos durante al menos un año.

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: Eliminan el efecto de las nuevas aperturas y cierres, por lo que son un indicador más claro de la demanda subyacente.

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: Busque la dirección y el ritmo de cambio, no solo la cifra de un solo trimestre.

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. Tráfico frente a ticket promedio

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: Las ventas comparables se pueden dividir en dos partes: el número de transacciones (tráfico) y el monto promedio gastado por transacción (ticket).

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: El aumento de las ventas impulsado principalmente por precios más altos cuenta una historia muy diferente a la de las ventas impulsadas por más compradores que adquieren más artículos.

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: Cuando las empresas revelan ambos, compárelos.

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. Niveles de inventario

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: El inventario es una pista de cuán confiado se siente un minorista.

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: Un inventario reducido puede indicar disciplina, o un riesgo de estantes vacíos.

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: Un inventario inflado puede indicar una demanda débil y una próxima ronda de rebajas.

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: Observe cómo se compara el crecimiento del inventario con el crecimiento de las ventas.

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
segments.tr: ### 4. Márgenes

segments.src: Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: Los márgenes brutos y operativos muestran cuánto de cada dólar de ventas conserva la empresa después de los costos.

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: Las presiones pueden provenir del flete, los salarios, la merma (robo y pérdida), las promociones y la mezcla de productos.

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: Los ejecutivos a menudo explican los cambios en los márgenes en detalle, y vale la pena leer esas explicaciones detenidamente.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. Comercio electrónico y crecimiento digital

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: Los pedidos en línea, la entrega en el mismo día, la recogida en la acera y los medios minoristas (publicidad vendida en las propias plataformas de un minorista) se han convertido en partes importantes de la historia.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: El crecimiento en estas áreas puede aumentar las ventas y las ganancias, pero también puede traer mayores costos de cumplimiento.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. Orientación (Guidance)

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: Las empresas suelen ofrecer una perspectiva para el resto del año fiscal.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: Ya sea que la aumenten, mantengan o reduzcan, y cuánto margen de maniobra incluyan, a menudo mueve la conversación más que el trimestre recién completado.

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## Leer entre líneas los comentarios de los ejecutivos

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: Las llamadas de ganancias están guionizadas en parte, pero aun así surgen patrones.

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: Algunas cosas a las que prestar atención:

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?
segments.tr: - **Cambiar a productos más baratos o más caros (Trading down or trading up).** ¿Están los compradores eligiendo marcas de la tienda, tamaños de paquete más pequeños o alternativas más baratas? ¿O siguen comprando artículos premium?

segments.src: - **Promotions and discounts.** Heavier discounting early in the season may suggest that retailers are working harder to win sales.
segments.tr: - **Promociones y descuentos.** Un mayor descuento al principio de la temporada puede sugerir que los minoristas están trabajando más duro para ganar ventas.

segments.src: - **Big-ticket hesitation.** Home Depot's remarks about large projects, and Target's remarks about discretionary goods, can reveal how willing households are to make larger purchases.
segments.tr: - **Vacilación ante compras costosas.** Los comentarios de Home Depot sobre grandes proyectos y los comentarios de Target sobre bienes discrecionales pueden revelar qué tan dispuestos están los hogares a realizar compras más grandes.

segments.src: - **Credit and payment habits.** Mentions of buy-now-pay-later use, or shoppers stretching paychecks between pay dates, hint at budget strain.
segments.tr: - **Hábitos de crédito y pago.** Las menciones sobre el uso de compre ahora y pague después, o los compradores que estiran sus cheques de pago entre fechas de cobro, sugieren una presión presupuestaria.

segments.src: - **Tariffs, supply chains and pricing.** Executives often discuss how costs are passed along, absorbed or avoided through sourcing changes.
segments.tr: - **Aranceles, cadenas de suministro y precios.** Los ejecutivos a menudo discuten cómo se trasladan, absorben o evitan los costos mediante cambios en el abastecimiento.

segments.src: - **Holiday expectations.** Cautious language about timing, early shopping or shorter gift lists is worth noting.
segments.tr: - **Expectativas para las fiestas.** Vale la pena notar el lenguaje cauteloso sobre los tiempos, las compras anticipadas o las listas de regalos más cortas.

segments.src: ## Putting It in Context
segments.tr: ## Ponerlo en contexto

segments.src: A few cautions help keep the reading honest:
segments.tr: Alguna precauciones ayudan a mantener la lectura honesta:

segments.src: 1. **One quarter is not a trend.** Weather, calendar shifts and one-time events can distort a single period.
segments.tr: 1. **Un trimestre no es una tendencia.** El clima, los cambios en el calendario y los eventos únicos pueden distorsionar un solo período.

segments.src: 2. **Compare against expectations.** Markets react to results relative to forecasts, not only to the raw figures.
segments.tr: 2. **Compare con las expectativas.** Los mercados reaccionan a los resultados en relación con los pronósticos, no solo a las cifras brutas.

segments.src: 3. **Companies report their own view.** Pair earnings with independent data such as government retail sales and inflation reports, consumer sentiment surveys and credit data.
segments.tr: 3. **Las empresas reportan su propia visión.** Combine las ganancias con datos independientes, como informes gubernamentales de ventas minoristas e inflación, encuestas de sentimiento del consumidor y datos de crédito.

segments.src: 4. **Averages hide differences.** Households with different incomes, ages and regions can behave very differently within the same quarter.
segments.tr: 4. **Los promedios ocultan diferencias.** Los hogares con diferentes ingresos, edades y regiones pueden comportarse de manera muy diferente dentro del mismo trimestre.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Readers
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los lectores cotidianos

segments.tr: No necesita poseer una sola acción para beneficiarse de estos informes.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.tr: Los informes de mediados de noviembre de Walmart, Target y Home Depot funcionan como un boletín de calificaciones para la economía del consumidor.

segments.tr: هذا النطاق الواسع يجعل موسم أرباحها أحد أفضل اللقطات العامة للإنفاق الأسري قبل العطلات مباشرة.

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا الدليل ماهية هذه التقارير، والأرقام التي تستحق الاهتمام، وكيفية قراءة تعليقات المسؤولين التنفيذيين بعين ناقدة.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: هذه معلومات عامة وليست نصيحة استثمارية، وهي لا تتنبأ بنتائج أي شركة.

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## لماذا هذه الشركات الثلاث؟

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: تقع كل واحدة منها في جزء مختلف من ميزانية الأسرة.

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **وول مارت** هي أكبر بائع للبقالة في البلاد وبائع رئيسي للسلع اليومية. يمتد عملاؤها عبر مجموعة واسعة من مستويات الدخل، لذا فإن نتائجها غالبًا ما تظهر كيف يتصرف المتسوقون المهتمون بالميزانية والمتسوقون ذوو الدخل المرتفع على حد سواء.

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **تارجت** تميل نحو الفئات الاختيارية مثل الملابس، وديكور المنزل، والألعاب، والسلع الموسمية. وهي تميل إلى أن تكون أكثر حساسية للتحولات في ثقة المستهلك.

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **هوم ديبوت** هي نافذة على سوق الإسكان وتحسين المنازل. تظهر المشاريع الكبيرة، والإصلاحات، وطلب المقاولين المحترفين جميعها في أرقامها.

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: قراءة التقارير الثلاثة جنبًا إلى جنب تعطي صورة أكمل مما يمكن لأي منها تقديمه بمفرده.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## الأرقام التي تستحق المراقبة

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. المبيعات القابلة للمقارنة

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: "المبيعات القابلة للمقارنة" (أو "comps") تقيس المبيعات في المتاجر والقنوات المفتوحة لمدة عام على الأقل.

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: وهي تستبعد تأثير الافتتاحات والإغلاقات الجديدة، لذا فهي مقياس أنظف للطلب الأساسي.

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: ابحث عن اتجاه ووتيرة التغيير، وليس فقط رقم ربع واحد.

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. حركة المرور مقابل متوسط قيمة المعاملة

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: يمكن تقسيم المبيعات القابلة للمقارنة إلى جزأين: عدد المعاملات (حركة المرور) ومتوسط المبلغ المنفق لكل معاملة (متوسط قيمة المعاملة).

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: المبيعات المتزايدة المدفوعة في الغالب بأسعار أعلى تحكي قصة مختلفة تمامًا عن المبيعات المدفوعة بمزيد من المتسوقين الذين يشترون المزيد من العناصر.

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: عندما تفصح الشركات عن كليهما، قارن بينهما.

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. مستويات المخزون

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: المخزون هو دليل على مدى ثقة بائع التجزئة.

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يشير المخزون المحدود إلى الانضباط، أو خطر وجود أرفف فارغة.

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يشير المخزون المتضخم إلى ضعف الطلب وجولة قادمة من التخفيضات.

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: راقب كيف يقارن نمو المخزون بنمو المبيعات.

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
segments.tr: ### 4. الهوامش

segments.src: Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: تُظهر الهوامش الإجمالية والتشغيلية مقدار ما تحتفظ به الشركة من كل دولار مبيعات بعد التكاليف.

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تأتي الضغوط من الشحن، والأجور، والانكماش (السرقة والخسارة)، والعروض الترويجية، ومزيج المنتجات.

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما يشرح المسؤولون التنفيذيون تغييرات الهامش بالتفصيل، وتلك التفسيرات تستحق القراءة بعناية.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. التجارة الإلكترونية والنمو الرقمي

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: أصبحت الطلبات عبر الإنترنت، والتوصيل في نفس اليوم، والاستلام من الرصيف، ووسائل إعلام التجزئة (الإعلانات المباعة على منصات بائع التجزئة الخاصة) أجزاء رئيسية من القصة.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: يمكن أن يؤدي النمو في هذه المجالات إلى رفع المبيعات والأرباح، لكنها قد تجلب أيضًا تكاليف تنفيذ أعلى.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. التوجيهات

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: تقدم الشركات عادةً توقعات لبقية السنة المالية.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: سواء قاموا برفعها أو الحفاظ عليها أو خفضها، ومقدار الهامش الذي يبنونه، غالبًا ما يحرك المحادثة أكثر من الربع الذي انتهى للتو.

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## قراءة ما بين السطور في تعليقات المسؤولين التنفيذيين

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: مكالمات الأرباح مكتوبة جزئيًا، ومع ذلك تظهر أنماط.

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: بضعة أشياء يجب الاستماع إليها:

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?
segments.tr: - **التداول للأسفل أو التداول للأعلى.** هل يختار المتسوقون العلامات التجارية للمتجر، أو أحجام العبوات الأصغر، أو البدائل الأرخص؟ أم أنهم ما زالوا يشترون سلعًا ممتازة؟

segments.src: - **Promotions and discounts.** Heavier discounting early in the season may suggest that retailers are working harder to win sales.
segments.tr: - **العروض الترويجية والخصومات.** قد تشير الخصومات الأكبر في وقت مبكر من الموسم إلى أن تجار التجزئة يعملون بجد أكبر للفوز بالمبيعات.

segments.src: - **Big-ticket hesitation.** Home Depot's remarks about large projects, and Target's remarks about discretionary goods, can reveal how willing households are to make larger purchases.
segments.tr: - **التردد في السلع باهظة الثمن.** يمكن لملاحظات هوم ديبوت حول المشاريع الكبيرة، وملاحظات تارجت حول السلع الاختيارية، أن تكشف عن مدى استعداد الأسر للقيام بعمليات شراء أكبر.

segments.src: - **Credit and payment habits.** Mentions of buy-now-pay-later use, or shoppers stretching paychecks between pay dates, hint at budget strain.
segments.tr: - **عادات الائتمان والدفع.** تشير الإشارات إلى استخدام "اشترِ الآن وادفع لاحقًا"، أو المتسوقين الذين يمددون رواتبهم بين تواريخ الدفع، إلى ضغوط الميزانية.

segments.src: - **Tariffs, supply chains and pricing.** Executives often discuss how costs are passed along, absorbed or avoided through sourcing changes.
segments.tr: - **التعريفات الجمركية، وسلاسل التوريد، والتسعير.** غالبًا ما يناقش المسؤولون التنفيذيون كيفية تمرير التكاليف، أو امتصاصها، أو تجنبها من خلال تغييرات المصادر.

segments.src: - **Holiday expectations.** Cautious language about timing, early shopping or shorter gift lists is worth noting.
segments.tr: - **توقعات العطلات.** تجدر الإشارة إلى اللغة الحذرة حول التوقيت، أو التسوق المبكر، أو قوائم الهدايا الأقصر.

segments.src: ## Putting It in Context
segments.tr: ## وضع الأمور في سياقها

segments.src: A few cautions help keep the reading honest:
segments.tr: تساعد بعض التحذيرات في الحفاظ على نزاهة القراءة:

segments.src: 1. **One quarter is not a trend.** Weather, calendar shifts and one-time events can distort a single period.
segments.tr: 1. **ربع واحد ليس اتجاهًا.** يمكن للطقس، وتغيرات التقويم، والأحداث لمرة واحدة أن تشوه فترة واحدة.

segments.src: 2. **Compare against expectations.** Markets react to results relative to forecasts, not only to the raw figures.
segments.tr: 2. **قارن مقابل التوقعات.** تتفاعل الأسواق مع النتائج بالنسبة للتوقعات، وليس فقط مع الأرقام الخام.

segments.src: 3. **Companies report their own view.** Pair earnings with independent data such as government retail sales and inflation reports, consumer sentiment surveys and credit data.
segments.tr: 3. **الشركات تبلغ عن وجهة نظرها الخاصة.** قم بإقران الأرباح ببيانات مستقلة مثل مبيعات التجزئة الحكومية وتقارير التضخم، واستطلاعات ثقة المستهلك، وبيانات الائتمان.

segments.src: 4. **Averages hide differences.** Households with different incomes, ages and regions can behave very differently within the same quarter.
segments.tr: 4. **المتوسطات تخفي الاختلافات.** يمكن للأسر ذات الدخول والأعمار والمناطق المختلفة أن تتصرف بشكل مختلف تمامًا خلال نفس الربع.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Readers
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني هذا للقراء العاديين

segments.src: You do not need to own a single share to benefit from these reports.
segments.tr: لا تحتاج إلى امتلاك سهم واحد للاستفادة من هذه التقارير.

segments.src: If you are planning holiday spending, early discounts and strong inventories may mean better deals, while cautious retailers might limit selection on popular items.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تخطط لإنفاق العطلات، فقد تعني الخصومات المبكرة والمخزونات القوية صفقات أفضل، بينما قد يحد تجار التجزئة الحذرون من اختيار العناصر الشائعة.

segments.src: If you work in retail, logistics or construction, the commentary hints at hiring and demand ahead.
segments.tr: إذا كنت تعمل في مجال التجزئة أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو البناء، فإن التعليقات تلمح إلى التوظيف والطلب في المستقبل.

segments.src: And if you simply want to understand the economy, these earnings calls are one of the most readable, plain-language views of how Americans are spending.
segments.tr: وإذا كنت ترغب ببساطة في فهم الاقتصاد، فإن مكالمات الأرباح هذه هي واحدة من أكثر وجهات النظر وضوحًا وبساطة حول كيفية إنفاق الأمريكيين.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The mid-November reports from Walmart, Target and Home Depot function like a report card for the consumer economy.
segments.tr: تعمل تقارير منتصف نوفمبر من وول مارت وتارجت وهوم ديبوت كبطاقة تقرير لاقتصاد المستهلك.

segments.src: Focus on comparable sales, traffic versus ticket, inventory, margins and guidance, then compare what executives say with independent data.
segments.tr: ركز على المبيعات القابلة للمقارنة، وحركة المرور مقابل متوسط قيمة المعاملة، والمخزون، والهوامش، والتوجيهات، ثم قارن ما يقوله المسؤولون التنفيذيون بالبيانات المستقلة.

segments.src: That approach gives you a grounded, balanced view of how the American shopper is really doing as the holiday season begins.
segments.tr: هذا النهج يمنحك نظرة متوازنة وراسخة حول كيفية أداء المتسوق الأمريكي حقًا مع بداية موسم العطلات.

fr.title: Bulletin de santé du secteur de la grande distribution : ce que les résultats de Walmart, Target et Home Depot révèlent sur le consommateur américain

segments.tr: Chaque mi-novembre, trois des plus grands détaillants américains publient leurs résultats trimestriels à quelques jours d'intervalle : Walmart, Target et Home Depot.

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: Ensemble, ils vendent des produits d'alimentation, des vêtements, des jouets, de l'électronique, des meubles, des outils et des matériaux de construction.

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: Cette diversité fait de leur saison de résultats l'un des meilleurs aperçus publics des dépenses des ménages juste avant les fêtes.

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique ce que sont ces rapports, quels chiffres méritent une attention particulière et comment lire le commentaire des dirigeants avec un œil critique.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, non de conseils en investissement, et cela ne prédit les résultats d'aucune entreprise.

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces trois entreprises ?

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: Chacune se situe dans une partie différente du budget des ménages.

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **Walmart** est le plus grand épicier du pays et un vendeur majeur de produits de consommation courante. Sa clientèle couvre un large éventail de revenus, ainsi ses résultats montrent souvent comment se comportent aussi bien les consommateurs soucieux de leur budget que ceux à revenus plus élevés.

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **Target** s'oriente davantage vers les catégories non essentielles telles que l'habillement, la décoration intérieure, les jouets et les articles saisonniers. Elle a tendance à être plus sensible aux variations de la confiance des consommateurs.

segments.tr: - **Home Depot** offre une fenêtre sur le marché de l'immobilier et de la rénovation résidentielle. Les grands projets, les réparations et la demande des entrepreneurs professionnels apparaissent tous dans ses chiffres.

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Les chiffres à surveiller

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. Ventes comparables

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: Les « ventes comparables » (ou « comps ») mesurent les ventes des magasins et canaux ouverts depuis au moins un an.

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: Elles éliminent l'effet des nouvelles ouvertures et des fermetures, fournissant ainsi une mesure plus nette de la demande sous-jacente.

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: Recherchez la direction et le rythme du changement, et pas seulement le chiffre d'un seul trimestre.

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. Fréquentation versus panier moyen

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: Les ventes comparables peuvent être divisées en deux parties : le nombre de transactions (fréquentation) et le montant moyen dépensé par transaction (panier moyen).

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: Une hausse des ventes principalement tirée par des prix plus élevés raconte une histoire très différente de ventes stimulées par un plus grand nombre d'acheteurs se procurant davantage d'articles.

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: Lorsque les entreprises divulguent les deux, comparez-les.

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. Niveaux de stocks

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: Le stock est un indice du niveau de confiance d'un détaillant.

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: Un stock restreint peut signaler une bonne discipline ou un risque de rayons meublés d'espaces vides.

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: Un stock excessif peut signaler une faible demande et une vague à venir de démarques.

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: Observez comment la croissance des stocks se compare à la croissance des ventes.

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
segments.tr: ### 4. Marges

segments.src: Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: Les marges brutes et opérationnelles montrent quelle part de chaque dollar de vente l'entreprise conserve après déduction des coûts.

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: Les pressions peuvent provenir du fret, des salaires, de la démarque inconnue (vols et pertes), des promotions et du mix produit.

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: Les dirigeants expliquent souvent en détail les variations de marge, et ces explications valent la peine d'être lues attentivement.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. Commerce électronique et croissance numérique

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: Les commandes en ligne, la livraison le jour même, le retrait en Drive et le retail media (la publicité vendue sur les propres plateformes du détaillant) sont devenus des éléments majeurs de l'histoire.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: La croissance dans ces domaines peut augmenter les ventes et les bénéfices, mais elle peut aussi entraîner des coûts de traitement des commandes plus élevés.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. Prévisions

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: Les entreprises donnent généralement des perspectives pour le reste de l'exercice fiscal.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: Qu'elles les rehaussent, les maintiennent ou les abaissent, et la marge de sécurité qu'elles y intègrent, influence souvent davantage le débat que le trimestre qui vient de s'achever.

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## Lire entre les lignes des commentaires des dirigeants

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: Les appels sur les résultats sont en partie scénarisés, pourtant des tendances émergent toujours.

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: Voici quelques éléments à guetter :

pt.title: Boletim do Varejo: O Que os Resultados de Walmart, Target e Home Depot Revelam Sobre o Consumidor Americano

segments.src: Every mid-November, three of America's biggest retailers report quarterly results within days of one another: Walmart, Target and Home Depot.
segments.tr: Meados de novembro de cada ano, três dos maiores varejistas dos Estados Unidos divulgam seus resultados trimestrais com poucos dias de diferença: Walmart, Target e Home Depot.

segments.src: Together they sell groceries, clothing, toys, electronics, furniture, tools and building supplies.
segments.tr: Juntos, eles vendem alimentos, roupas, brinquedos, eletrônicos, móveis, ferramentas e materiais de construção.

segments.src: That breadth makes their earnings season one of the best public snapshots of household spending just before the holidays.
segments.tr: Essa variedade torna a temporada de balanços uma das melhores radiografias públicas dos gastos das famílias pouco antes das festas de fim de ano.

segments.src: This guide covers what these reports are, which numbers deserve attention, and how to read executive commentary with a critical eye.
segments.tr: Este guia explica o que são esses relatórios, quais números merecem atenção e como ler os comentários dos executivos com um olhar crítico.

segments.src: It is general information, not investment advice, and it does not predict any company's results.
segments.tr: Trata-se de informação geral, não de conselho de investimento, e não prevê os resultados de nenhuma empresa.

segments.src: ## Why These Three Companies?
segments.tr: ## Por Que Essas Três Empresas?

segments.src: Each one sits in a different part of the household budget.
segments.tr: Cada uma se situa em uma parte diferente do orçamento familiar.

segments.src: - **Walmart** is the country's largest grocer and a major seller of everyday goods. Its customers span a wide range of incomes, so its results often show how both budget-conscious and higher-income shoppers are behaving.
segments.tr: - **Walmart** é a maior rede de supermercados do país e um grande vendedor de bens do dia a dia. Seus clientes abrangem uma ampla faixa de renda, portanto seus resultados costumam mostrar como tanto os consumidores atentos ao orçamento quanto os de maior renda estão se comportando.

segments.src: - **Target** leans toward discretionary categories such as apparel, home decor, toys and seasonal items. It tends to be more sensitive to shifts in consumer confidence.
segments.tr: - **Target** é mais voltada para categorias discricionárias, como vestuário, decoração, brinquedos e itens sazonais. Ela tende a ser mais sensível a mudanças na confiança do consumidor.

segments.src: - **Home Depot** is a window into the housing market and home improvement. Big projects, repairs and professional contractor demand all show up in its numbers.
segments.tr: - **Home Depot** é uma janela para o mercado imobiliário e a melhoria do lar. Grandes projetos, reformas e a demanda de empreiteiros profissionais aparecem em seus números.

segments.src: Reading the three side by side gives a fuller picture than any one of them can offer alone.
segments.tr: Ler as três lado a lado oferece um panorama mais completo do que qualquer uma delas pode fornecer sozinha.

segments.src: ## The Numbers Worth Watching
segments.tr: ## Os Números que Valem a Pena Acompanhar

segments.src: ### 1. Comparable Sales
segments.tr: ### 1. Vendas Comparáveis (Same-Store Sales)

segments.src: "Comparable sales" (or "comps") measure sales at stores and channels open for at least a year.
segments.tr: As "vendas comparáveis" (ou "comps") medem as vendas em lojas e canais abertos há pelo menos 1 ano.

segments.src: They strip out the effect of new openings and closures, so they are a cleaner gauge of underlying demand.
segments.tr: Elas eliminam o efeito de novas aberturas e fechamentos, servindo como um indicador mais limpo da demanda subjacente.

segments.src: Look for the direction and the pace of change, not just a single quarter's figure.
segments.tr: Observe a direção e o ritmo de mudança, e não apenas o valor de um único trimestre.

segments.src: ### 2. Traffic Versus Ticket
segments.tr: ### 2. Tráfego Versus Ticket Médio

segments.src: Comparable sales can be split into two parts: the number of transactions (traffic) and the average amount spent per transaction (ticket).
segments.tr: As vendas comparáveis podem ser divididas em duas partes: o número de transações (tráfego) e o valor médio gasto por transação (ticket).

segments.src: Rising sales driven mostly by higher prices tell a very different story from sales driven by more shoppers buying more items.
segments.tr: O aumento das vendas impulsionado principalmente por preços mais altos conta uma história muito diferente de vendas impulsionadas por mais consumidores comprando mais itens.

segments.src: When companies disclose both, compare them.
segments.tr: Quando as empresas divulgam ambos, compare-os.

segments.src: ### 3. Inventory Levels
segments.tr: ### 3. Níveis de Estoque

segments.src: Inventory is a clue to how confident a retailer feels.
segments.tr: O estoque é uma pista de quão confiante o varejista se sente.

segments.src: Lean inventory can signal discipline, or a risk of empty shelves.
segments.tr: Um estoque enxuto pode sinalizar disciplina ou o risco de prateleiras vazias.

segments.src: Swollen inventory can signal weak demand and a coming round of markdowns.
segments.tr: Um estoque elevado pode sinalizar demanda fraca e uma rodada iminente de remarcações.

segments.src: Watch how inventory growth compares with sales growth.
segments.tr: Observe como o crescimento do estoque se compara com o crescimento das vendas.

segments.src: ### 4. Margins
segments.tr: ### 4. Margens

segments.src: Gross and operating margins show how much of each sales dollar the company keeps after costs.
segments.tr: As margens bruta e operacional mostram quanto de cada dólar vendido a empresa retém após os custos.

segments.src: Pressures can come from freight, wages, shrink (theft and loss), promotions and product mix.
segments.tr: Pressões podem vir de frete, salários, perdas (roubo e extravio), promoções e mix de produtos.

segments.src: Executives often explain margin changes in detail, and those explanations are worth reading closely.
segments.tr: Os executivos costumam explicar as alterações de margem em detalhes, e vale a pena ler essas explicações atentamente.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. E-Commerce e Crescimento Digital

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: Pedidos online, entrega no mesmo dia, retirada na loja (curbside pickup) e mídia de varejo (publicidade vendida nas próprias plataformas do varejista) tornaram-se partes fundamentais do negócio.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: O crescimento nessas áreas pode elevar as vendas e os lucros, mas também pode trazer custos de fulfillment mais altos.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. Projeções (Guidance)

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: As empresas geralmente fornecem uma perspectiva para o restante do ano fiscal.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: O fato de aumentarem, manterem ou reduzirem essa projeção, e a margem de segurança que incorporam, costuma movimentar mais as discussões do que o trimestre recém-concluído.

segments.tr: Para eksekutif sering kali menjelaskan perubahan margin secara rinci, dan penjelasan tersebut layak untuk dibaca secara saksama.

segments.src: ### 5. E-Commerce and Digital Growth
segments.tr: ### 5. E-Commerce dan Pertumbuhan Digital

segments.src: Online orders, same-day delivery, curbside pickup and retail media (advertising sold on a retailer's own platforms) have become major parts of the story.
segments.tr: Pesanan online, pengiriman di hari yang sama, pengambilan di tepi jalan (curbside pickup), dan media ritel (periklanan yang dijual di platform peritel itu sendiri) telah menjadi bagian utama dari cerita ini.

segments.src: Growth in these areas can lift sales and profits, but they may also bring higher fulfillment costs.
segments.tr: Pertumbuhan di bidang-bidang ini dapat meningkatkan penjualan dan laba, tetapi juga dapat membawa biaya pemenuhan pesanan yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ### 6. Guidance
segments.tr: ### 6. Panduan Bisnis (Guidance)

segments.src: Companies usually give an outlook for the rest of the fiscal year.
segments.tr: Perusahaan biasanya memberikan prospek untuk sisa tahun fiskal.

segments.src: Whether they raise, maintain or lower it, and how much cushion they build in, often moves the conversation more than the quarter just completed.
segments.tr: Apakah mereka menaikkan, mempertahankan, atau menurunkan target tersebut, dan seberapa banyak cadangan yang mereka bangun, sering kali menggerakkan perbincangan lebih dari sekadar kuartal yang baru saja diselesaikan.

segments.src: ## Reading Between the Lines of Executive Comments
segments.tr: ## Membaca Tersirat dari Komentar Eksekutif

segments.src: Earnings calls are scripted in part, yet patterns still emerge.
segments.tr: Konferensi pers laporan keuangan sebagian telah disiapkan naskahnya, namun pola-pola tetap muncul.

segments.src: A few things to listen for:
segments.tr: Beberapa hal yang perlu didengarkan:

segments.src: - **Trading down or trading up.** Are shoppers choosing store brands, smaller pack sizes or cheaper alternatives? Or are they still buying premium items?
segments.tr: - **Beralih ke produk yang lebih murah atau lebih mahal (Trading down or trading up).** Apakah pembeli memilih merek toko, ukuran kemasan yang lebih kecil, atau alternatif yang lebih murah? Atau apakah mereka masih membeli barang-barang premium?

segments.src: - **Promotions and discounts.** Heavier discounting early in the season may suggest that retailers are working harder to win sales.
segments.tr: - **Promosi dan diskon.** Pemberian diskon yang lebih besar di awal musim dapat menunjukkan bahwa peritel bekerja lebih keras untuk memenangkan penjualan.

segments.src: - **Big-ticket hesitation.** Home Depot's remarks about large projects, and Target's remarks about discretionary goods, can reveal how willing households are to make larger purchases.
segments.tr: - **Keraguan pada pembelian barang bernilai tinggi.** Pernyataan Home Depot tentang proyek-proyek besar, dan pernyataan Target tentang barang-barang diskresioner, dapat mengungkapkan seberapa besar kesiapan rumah tangga untuk melakukan pembelian yang lebih besar.

segments.src: - **Credit and payment habits.** Mentions of buy-now-pay-later use, or shoppers stretching paychecks between pay dates, hint at budget strain.
segments.tr: - **Kebiasaan kredit dan pembayaran.** Penyebutan penggunaan layanan beli sekarang bayar nanti (buy-now-pay-later), atau pembeli yang meregangkan anggaran gaji di antara tanggal penggajian, mengisyaratkan adanya tekanan anggaran.

segments.src: - **Tariffs, supply chains and pricing.** Executives often discuss how costs are passed along, absorbed or avoided through sourcing changes.
segments.tr: - **Tarif, rantai pasokan, dan penetapan harga.** Para eksekutif sering membahas bagaimana biaya diteruskan, diserap, atau dihindari melalui perubahan sumber pengadaan.

segments.src: - **Holiday expectations.** Cautious language about timing, early shopping or shorter gift lists is worth noting.
segments.tr: - **Harapan liburan.** Bahasa yang penuh kehati-hatian mengenai waktu, belanja lebih awal, atau daftar hadiah yang lebih pendek patut dicatat.

segments.src: ## Putting It in Context
segments.tr: ## Menempatkannya dalam Konteks

segments.src: A few cautions help keep the reading honest:
segments.tr: Beberapa peringatan membantu menjaga pembacaan tetap objektif:

segments.src: 1. **One quarter is not a trend.** Weather, calendar shifts and one-time events can distort a single period.
segments.tr: 1. **Satu kuartal bukanlah sebuah tren.** Cuaca, pergeseran kalender, dan peristiwa satu kali dapat mendistorsi satu periode tunggal.

segments.src: 2. **Compare against expectations.** Markets react to results relative to forecasts, not only to the raw figures.
segments.tr: 2. **Bandingkan dengan ekspektasi.** Pasar bereaksi terhadap hasil relatif terhadap perkiraan, bukan hanya terhadap angka mentahnya.

segments.src: 3. **Companies report their own view.** Pair earnings with independent data such as government retail sales and inflation reports, consumer sentiment surveys and credit data.
segments.tr: 3. **Perusahaan melaporkan sudut pandang mereka sendiri.** Padukan laporan laba dengan data independen seperti penjualan ritel pemerintah dan laporan inflasi, survei sentimen konsumen, dan data kredit.

segments.src: 4. **Averages hide differences.** Households with different incomes, ages and regions can behave very differently within the same quarter.
segments.tr: 4. **Rata-rata menyembunyikan perbedaan.** Rumah tangga dengan pendapatan, usia, dan wilayah yang berbeda dapat berperilaku sangat berbeda dalam kuartal yang sama.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Readers
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Pembaca Sehari-hari

segments.tr: Anda tidak perlu memiliki satu lembar saham pun untuk mendapatkan manfaat dari laporan-laporan ini.

segments.tr: Jika Anda bekerja di bidang ritel, logistik, atau konstruksi, komentar tersebut mengisyaratkan tentang perekrutan dan permintaan di masa mendatang.

segments.src: And if you simply want to understand the economy, these earnings calls are one of the most readable, plain-language views of how Americans are spending.
segments.tr: Dan jika Anda hanya ingin memahami perekonomian, konferensi pers laporan keuangan ini adalah salah satu pandangan yang paling mudah dibaca dan menggunakan bahasa yang sederhana tentang bagaimana orang Amerika membelanjakan uangnya.
